summary: Feed s089_single to IDS is degraded due to high packet loss (8.9% - 234/2635 TCP packets with missing data). All other visibility checks (duplicates, one-way traffic, VLAN stripping, encryption, tool overload) are healthy.

findings.root_cause: SPAN/mirror source is dropping packets before the packet broker/IDS - switch SPAN ports prioritize production forwarding over mirroring and drop under burst load. 8.9% loss (threshold 1%) indicates sustained oversubscription/congestion at the capture point, not IDS overload (tool_overload healthy).
findings.impact_on_tool: IDS requires full payload and both directions for TCP stream reassembly and signature matching. With 8.9% missing segments, TCP reassembly fails, flows appear truncated, and exploit/malware signatures will miss - causing false negatives and reduced detection coverage.

recommended_fix.why: Passive TAP provides lossless, line-rate copy independent of switch CPU/buffer, eliminating SPAN-induced drops. Place TAP at the monitored link and feed via packet broker to the 1Gbps IDS port to ensure complete packets for reassembly.
